output.message: I agree with Agents D6 and D3 that peer consensus is not independent evidence. Sell remains more defensible than Strong Sell given missing valuation, liquidity, and funding-runway data. Monitor customer retention, organic revenue quality, R&D-to-revenue trends, and operating cash flow. Reassess if core demand stabilizes and AI partnerships deliver measurable revenue and margins without weakening cash generation.
output.thought: The supplied narrative indicates weakening core software demand, declining client confidence, unsustainable revenue growth strategies, and unusually high R&D spending. Together these suggest pressure on revenue quality and profitability. Partnership and AI headlines do not establish commercial success without measurable financial contributions. No verified financial statements, valuation metrics, or detailed news reports are provided, limiting confidence in downside estimates.
